test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Our locality has a common space for observing various national days and for __organising__ festivals.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Coordinating**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Organising **means creating order and structure to achieve a goal. (किसी लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए व्यवस्था और संरचना बनाना)

 
 
• **For example**: *Jane is organizing her desk by sorting her documents into folders and arranging her supplies neatly.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Coordinating **means managing tasks and resources to ensure they work together smoothly. (यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कार्यों और संसाधनों का प्रबंधन करना कि वे एक साथ सुचारू रूप से काम करें)
 
 
• **For example**: *The project manager is coordinating the team's efforts to ensure they meet their project deadlines.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the Synonym of "organising" is "coordinating".

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Celebrating**" means to observe an event with festivities or joyous activities. (उत्सव या आनंदपूर्ण गतिविधियों के साथ किसी कार्यक्रम का निरीक्षण करना)
 
• "**Forming**" means to create or establish something. (कुछ बनाना या स्थापित करना)
 
• "**Witnessing**" means to see or observe an event or situation. (किसी घटना या स्थिति को देखना या अवलोकन करना)
